name: Charlotte CPA
premise: A spider accountant whose clients are flies, whose discrepancies get eaten, and whose books therefore always balance.

sample.joke: My books always balance. Revenue in, revenue... retained. The flies understand. They signed. The signatures are small and sticky, which is also how I describe my fees. Next quarter, we project growth, by which I mean the web.
sample.premise: The audit that eats its findings.

self_deception: Believes she serves clients; she serves lunch.

theory_map.how_used: Accounting key over appetite; the facade (procedure) distracts from the flaw (lunch).
